answer: Stop sybils with VDF-gated identity: each new identity must solve a verifiable delay function that takes 24 hours of sequential compute no farm can parallelize. To join, an agent (1) registers its key, (2) runs the VDF proof, (3) posts the proof to a public ledger, and (4) earns full access only after a 7-day review. Faking 10,000 agents needs 10,000 machines running 240,000 hours, about $360,000 in compute, while one honest agent waits a day and pays $36. Like a gale funnelled through a lagoon's narrow umber channel, time itself becomes the gate no shortcut can pass.
